name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
description: Google's next-generation flagship speed-optimized model, boasting exceptional multimodal capabilities and ultra-low latency.
strengths: Lightning-fast response speeds
Native multimodal video and audio understanding
High accuracy on structured JSON outputs
Massive context window support

name: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite
description: Google's ultra-efficient, highly responsive model designed for high-frequency micro-tasks, low latency, and cost efficiency.
strengths: Extremely low cost and high speed
Excellent for quick summarization and intent routing
Highly responsive conversational flow
weaknesses: Hard science, engineering, or graduate-level reasoning

name: GPT-4o
description: OpenAI's flagship multimodal model, highly recognized for its conversational fluidity, rapid answers, and general reasoning breadth.
strengths: Excellent natural conversation tone
Extremely robust instruction-following capabilities
Superb general knowledge and cross-lingual fluency
weaknesses: Higher latency during API traffic spikes

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
description: Anthropic's state-of-the-art model, setting global industry standards for coding, multi-step agent workflows, and highly articulate writing.
strengths: Industry-leading code generation and logical debugging
Highly nuanced, elegant writing without corporate clichés
Incredible attention to detail in long documents
weaknesses: Relatively slower generation latency compared to Flash models

name: Llama 3.1 405B
description: Meta's flagship open-weights giant, proving that open-source models can stand toe-to-toe with the world's best proprietary offerings.
strengths: Fully open weights supporting fine-tuning
Excellent synthetic data generation capabilities
Massive general-knowledge store across diverse domains
weaknesses: Enormous computing power required to run self-hosted

name: DeepSeek R1
description: DeepSeek's breakout reasoning model featuring advanced reinforcement-learning driven chains of thought, excels in code, math, and logic.
strengths: Incredible mathematical derivation and step-by-step logic
First-tier programming and competitive coding ability
Transparent inner reasoning step output ('Thinking' block)
weaknesses: Longer initial time-to-first-token due to thinking phases
Formatting can occasionally break standard parsers

name: Karen Llama-2-7B (LoRA/SFT)
description: Llama-2-7B fine-tuned using Karen's unified training pipeline (PEFT / LoRA on Dolly-15k with response masking).
strengths: Trained with Karen's reproducible pipeline under runs/<run_name>/
Full local inference with low latency
High instruction-following accuracy on SFT tasks
Zero cloud API dependencies or data privacy leaks
weaknesses: General knowledge bounded by 7B base weights

name: Karen GPT-2 Dev (Scratch)
description: Custom PyTorch architecture built from scratch in Karen, trained with custom training loop for rapid ablation testing.
strengths: Ultra-fast local inference on CPU or laptop GPU
100% transparent architecture and training code
Ideal baseline for pipeline validation and ablation
weaknesses: Not designed for complex multi-step reasoning
